record.question: The most severe form of lupus nephritis is:
record.explanation: Answer C: Class IV (diffuse proliferative). Class IV lupus nephritis is diffuse proliferative nephritis and is the most extensive proliferative class among the listed choices. Class VI (advanced sclerosing) is not offered, so “most severe” is imprecise without a classification frame. Reference: https://kdigo.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/KDIGO-2024-Lupus-Nephritis-Guideline.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
